title: The WP Customer Area plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name'…
description: The WP Customer Area plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'display_name' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 8.4.0. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
